summary: Split the input at full color-5 rows into equal sections and use the last three. Compute the changed cells in each of the two latest transitions and infer their horizontal displacement from the minimum changed columns. Apply the latest changes one more displacement to the final section. If a row changed in the prior transition but not the latest, carry that old-to-new replacement to the first later matching old-color cell in the final section. Return only the predicted next section.
